hooks.does: emit sense.new, once a session, for each event name or field the senses manifest (hooks/senses.ts) does not know; outermost, e passed on as it came
emit a permission request that reaches the person as tool.wait on the call in flight
emit each end of turn's snapshot of background shells, monitors and wakeups as tasks, with the turn's effort and permission mode and the instruction files loaded since the last
emit an agent's report as its agent.end, the report passed on
emit each spawn the engine started as agent.spawn, under the id and model it answered
pin a spawn with no model, not a fork, under a premium parent to opus
/subether opens the recall pane asked
emit each prompt that is not meta, by its head, origin, slash command, attachment count, the turn it was typed over and its wait

the first prompt with an ask (origin.kind bridge, composer, coordinator, scheduled-trigger, sdk or slack-ping) under each session id seeds: sandman recall writes the start mark, its stdout one capped context block
append a typed prompt to the day's tool log, unjudged and unawaited
emit each compaction, then its end with the tokens before and after or why it was skipped
emit session.end under the ending id, ahead of the take
sandman take on every reason under the end bound
emit each usage reading that changed: context tokens, window, percent, cost and rate-limit windows
take the gauge reading; persist the five-hour window
emit session.start with the session's cwd, model, surface, whether a person is at it, its repository and working copy, entrypoint, kind, version, platform, surfaces and transcript
the gauge's first reading and a 15 s usage poll in interactive sessions
open the pane unasked, register /subether
emit each tool call's start and end by target and outcome, what the model read counted, read-only and an error's or denial's head, unawaited; outermost
append every call to the day's tool log; outermost, so it sees denials
deny a house-forbidden Bash command, marked in sandman's ledger first; fail closed
deny an Edit/Write to a .yml path, marked in sandman's ledger first; fail closed
keep each recall the agent pulls, by Bash or MCP, for the pane
emit each loop's turn.complete with its length, usage and a refusal's category; a workflow agent's is also its agent.end
emit each loop's turn.start
keep the main loop's effort for the gauge's flag
draw the gauge row under the prompt, the engine's hint beneath
draw the pane's body: a row per recall, its path, due work, always-set and sent lines by bank or topic
emit a settings or skills file changing under the session as config
emit each working directory change as cwd, from and to
emit each /add-dir as directory
emit an MCP server's question to the person as elicit, never the form
emit the person's answer to an MCP server's question as elicit with its action
keep each memory or rules file loaded for the next end of turn's tasks
emit each engine notification as notify with its head
emit each call the mode's classifier refused as tool.deny with the reason's head
emit each model switch as model, from and to, what was asked and by what

emit each start, resume, fork, /clear and compaction as session.open: source, title, mode, model, a resume's idle seconds and tokens, and at every opening but a compaction senses: the engine's version beside the one the manifest was surveyed at
emit each API error ending a turn as turn.fail with its class and the details' head
emit a team task completed as todo
emit a team task created as todo
emit a teammate gone quiet as teammate.idle
emit each slash command as command by name and origin, never its arguments; outermost
emit a typing burst in the prompt box as typing, at most one per 5 s, never the text
emit each @ path a prompt names as mention once read: how it attached, or the denial
emit a remote client joining as client, with where and how large it draws
emit a remote client leaving as client with its reason
emit each delivery as message.receive: origin, size, wake, never its text
emit each message sent as message.send: to whom, its head, who sent it, delivered
emit the person's Stop as stop, whether a turn was running
emit each skill expanded for the model as skill, with whose it is
emit each model request as step once its stream ends, every chunk passed on: model, effort, thinking, tools, stop reason, usage
emit each copy isolated for an agent or the session as worktree once answered
emit each copy given back as worktree.end once answered: released or kept
